existing_actual_used_state_evidence.actual_boundary_scope: Actual current McKernel application execution satisfies the accepted oracle for selected x87 control-word, MXCSR and YMM preservation across its syscall, futex and signal boundaries, within the admitted two-McKernel-CPU profile.

finite_existing_eligibility_facts.eligibility_limit: MPX advertised and MPX/PKRU xstate enabled do not prove actual use. PKU advertised with OSPKE clear is not an empirical PKRU preservation test or a bounded whole-workload nonuse proof. No claim of executing unavailable instructions.

existing_requirements_source.accepted_rule: For every selected application/library path, require preservation of every enabled user xstate component represented by the process XCR0 readback; the known exposed0x21f profile gives R={0:x87,1:SSE/MXCSR,2:YMM upper,3:MPX BNDREGS,4:MPX BNDCSR,9:PKRU}. This is a justified architectural upper bound, not evidence that exposure implies execution. It includes all state of every legal eligible dispatch variant under that profile.

scoped_direct_app_compiler_facts.new_distinct_ELF_checks: In each baseline6d1865a0/current024fa562/current1f51f0e3 ELF, directly inspected memchr detect installs that ELF own find_sse2. Current two find_sse2 target bodies were independently read and contain scalar/SSE instructions with no MPX/PKRU. Each ELF memmove resolver independently offers SSE/SSSE3/ERMS/AVX/AVX512 target names. These are scoped direct observations, not a transfer of old findings or a whole-library state closure.

bounded_libc_facts.pkru_candidates: Dynamic libc pkey_get@0x106c00 contains RDPKRU@0x106c0b; pkey_set@0x106c80 contains RDPKRU@0x106c92 and WRPKRU@0x106cad. Baseline C imports no pkey API, but that alone does not prove transitive library non-use.
bounded_libc_facts.entry_scope: Selected dynamic libc startup/early-init/pthread-create/start-thread/create-thread/clone-internal and loader startup/TLS/CPU-feature entry bodies inspected directly show no MPX/PKRU instructions. They have transitive/indirect calls; their absence is not extrapolated to all library code.
bounded_libc_facts.stop: Conservative all-enabled-state declaration removes the need to chase those calls solely to prove non-use. No broader callgraph/library audit proposed.

existing_requirements_source.meaning: Direct selected body/entry observations and no direct pkey imports do not close transitive/indirect libc applicability. Compiler flags do not bound all prebuilt libc paths. No new disassembly/library census performed.

one_exact_unproven_item.why_existing_mechanism_is_not_the_missin: Accepted full runtime XSAVE mask/extent save/copy/restore supports these components structurally; it neither shows actual requirement/nonuse nor empirical noninitial preservation.
